method.scope: Direct typed struct-member access and assignment classification for the exact active owner source snapshot, across all 29 module headers.
method.limits: Lexical access only. Does not resolve every interprocedural by-reference/copy alias, infer all callee mutation at call sites, or prove object identity for same-type objects in separate functions. No dependency absence is inferred. Use the exact source blob in authority for line-level locations.
